plot: At sunset on the frozen pond Max tries ice skating and turns every step into a gag (ear skates, eleven falls, a spin he can't stop, a snowball that grows into a snowman), Dog does accidental splits and becomes a pillow, Bird judges with absurd scores, Mouse skates perfectly and wins the trophy, and the next morning Max is the first one back on the ice.

script.title: Max Tried Ice Skating… It Did Not Go Well 😭

beats.say: I'm not sliding. I'm arriving. Very slowly. Sideways.
Max, the skates go on your feet. Not on your ears.
Ear skates are the future, Grandma. You'll see.
Max has been on the ice for nine seconds. He has fallen eleven times.
That wasn't a fall. That was me checking if the ice is real.
And is it real?
Extremely. My whole back agrees.
Hold on, buddy! I'm coming to save you!
Dog did not have a plan. Dog had four legs going in four directions.
Why is the floor running away from me?
Dog, the floor isn't moving. You are.
Then tell my legs. They stopped listening to me.
Both of you, slowly. Little steps. Like penguins.
Penguins have practice, Grandma. I have dignity.
He had dignity for two more seconds.
DIGNITY: 0
Good evening, everyone! Your judge has arrived!
We don't need a judge. We need a rope.
Max, for that last fall: technical score, two. Drama score, ten.
Ten? So I'm winning?
You're winning at falling. It's a very small trophy.
What's my score? I've been doing the splits for a minute.
Dog, that's not the splits. You're just stuck.
Then my score is a strong ten for being stuck.
Excuse me. Coming through. Left side, please.
Mouse glides across the pond like a tiny professional.
Mouse, how? You're the size of a sock!
Small feet, low center. Also I practiced every winter of my life.
I practiced too. Just now. For one minute.
Mouse: technical score, ten. Max: please leave the ice.
Fine. Watch this. The famous Max spin.
Max started spinning. Nobody had told him how to stop.
Grandma! Which way is the house? Every way is the house!
Put your tail down, Max! Use it like a brake!
My tail is not a brake! My tail is a decoration!
Don't worry, I'll stop him. With my face.
Dog did stop him. With his face.
I'm okay. I'm a pillow now. A happy pillow.
Thanks, buddy. You're the softest wall I've ever hit.
NEW GAME: SNOWBALLS
Forget skating. Snow is my sport. Watch me throw.
Max, gently. Don't throw it at Bird.
I would never. I'm throwing it at the sky.
The sky was very close to Bird.
Max! Penalty! Minus five hundred points!
Grandma, that's not even a real number!
It is now. Bird is the judge.
Bird threw it back. The snowball rolled downhill. And it grew.
Why is it bigger? Why is it bigger than me?
Run, Max! Wait, no. Don't run. It's ice.
Max did not run. Max sat down. Max became a snowman.
Everyone stay calm. I am a snowman now. I have a new life.
He's very round. I like him better like this.
Snowman Max: style, ten. Speed, zero. Hat, missing.
Max, you're not a snowman. You're a cat wearing a very cold jacket.
Shh, Grandma. Snowmen don't talk to people who don't believe in them.
Can I be a snowman too? I want a carrot nose. I would eat it, but still.
Snowman auditions are closed. One snowman per pond. Pond rules.
Who made the pond rules?
Me. Just now. I'm also the pond police.
Grandma, my paws feel like ice cubes. My whiskers feel like ice cubes. I'm a drink now.
Who wants hot cocoa? Everyone off the ice, please.
Cocoa! Finally a sport I'm good at!
Can a snowman drink cocoa? Asking for me.
Thirty seconds by the cocoa and Max is a cat again.
Now, the winter skating trophy goes to...
Me. It goes to me. Most falls. Biggest snowball.
...Mouse. For actually skating.
Thank you! I'd like to thank my small feet.
Grandma, I want to appeal. Bird gave me minus five hundred.
And I'd do it again. Judges never apologize.
Max, look. You can have my prize. It's a cocoa mustache.
Thank you, buddy. It suits you better.
Tomorrow we try again. With a helmet. And a rope.
Tomorrow I'm staying inside. Professionally.
Next morning, Max was the first one on the ice.
I'm not sliding. I'm arriving. Again.

long.title: Max Tried Ice Skating… It Did Not Go Well 😭

"I'm not sliding. I'm arriving. Very slowly. Sideways." 🐱
Max tries ice skating on the frozen pond: ear skates, a spin he can't stop, Dog doing accidental splits, Bird judging every fall… and a snowball that gets out of hand.
Could YOUR pet stand on ice? 👇
#MaxTheCuriousCat #IceSkating #FunnyCat
